title: Arc Raiders 与 The Finals 将改编为影视作品，Backrooms 联合制片人参与
content:
Arc Raiders and The Finals to be adapted to TV and film
Business
Business
News
Arc Raiders and The Finals set for TV and film adaptations from Backrooms co-producer
The Sweden-based Embark Studios has secured adaptations for both of its multiplayer shooters, The Finals and ARC Raiders.
Imran Khan
,
Contributor
October 5, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Image via Embark Studios/Nexon
Newsbrief:
Chernin Entertainment has announced that the television and production company will be creating adaptations for both The Finals and ARC Raiders.
Both games come from Embark Studios, with the former being a free-to-play multiplayer shooter, while ARC Raiders is a wildly popular extraction shooter that won Best Multiplayer Game at 2025’s The Game Awards. Earlier this year, Embark announced that
ARC Raiders had sold 14 million copies worldwide
.
For more information, be sure to read
Variety's
full report.
